reaction_smelter.txt fixture -- see PROVENANCE.md.

The flux boulder reagent line below is QUOTED verbatim, cited by the audit
to reaction_smelter.txt line 143 on the real install: REAGENT:B:1:BOULDER:
NO_SUBTYPE:NONE:NONE followed by REACTION_CLASS:FLUX. The reaction it sits
in, and the hematite reagent and iron bar product around it, are
ILLUSTRATIVE -- the audit describes the smelter alloy set (metals consumed:
IRON, SILVER, TIN, ZINC, COPPER, NICKEL, GOLD, BISMUTH, LEAD; alloys
produced: ADAMANTINE, BILLON, BRASS, BRONZE, ELECTRUM, STEEL) without
naming one specific reaction. This is the fixture set's one wholly-fixed
(non-parametric) product, for contrast against the brewing case.

[OBJECT:REACTION]

[REACTION:SMELT_HEMATITE_TO_IRON]
	[NAME:smelt hematite]
	[BUILDING:SMELTER:NONE]
	[SKILL:SMELT]
	[REAGENT:A:1:BOULDER:NO_SUBTYPE:INORGANIC:HEMATITE]
	flux reagent line -- QUOTED, reaction_smelter.txt:143 in the audit:
	[REAGENT:B:1:BOULDER:NO_SUBTYPE:NONE:NONE]
		[REACTION_CLASS:FLUX]
	[PRODUCT:100:4:BAR:NONE:METAL:IRON]
		[PRODUCT_DIMENSION:150]
